We followed distant lights, we crossed the years and seasons, we lost ourselves sometimes and found another way. There were nights without a moon, there were days without an answer, and places we remembered only because they disappeared. But somewhere in the distance there was always something calling. Not because the road was easy. Not because we never lost our way. But because, after all these years, we never stopped looking for the light.
